Chapter 687: Chapter 1: Sudden Increase In Strength (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 687: Chapter 1: Sudden Increase in Strength (Please Subscribe)_2

Normally, a Ninth Rank existence breaking through to the Tenth Rank wouldn’t cause such a disturbance.

It merely attracts the infusion of the Cosmic Origin Source from a million miles around. Not to mention those at the Eleventh Rank, even a Supreme Being would hardly notice.

Breaking through from Tenth Rank to Eleventh Rank? If it still triggers an infusion of the Cosmic Origin Source, the amount of disturbance it causes is still insignificant.

Choosing a deserted Star Domain to break through, one could pass through completely unnoticed.

And a Tenth Rank understanding the Rule of Time breaking through to Eleventh Rank? Since the beginning of this Cosmic Era, such occurrences can be counted on one hand; such Tenth Rank beings will seek the protection of a Supreme Being before breaking through.

Just like how Xia Qin Supreme Being and the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being set up a spacetime barrier for Lin Yuan’s breakthrough.

...

Human civilization, the Insect Race, the Tianyu Clan, and other peak clans don’t wish to see an Ultimate Being emerge from outside their own races, but the Twelfth-Rank Life of the Star Alliance does not share this view.

The Star Alliance is a force composed within the Cosmic Starry Skies by many special existences to resist the oppression of peak clans. Their Supreme Beings are very willing to protect powerful beings with no background.

As for breaking through from the Eleventh Rank to the Ultimate… the resulting disturbance far exceeds what happened when Lin Yuan broke through.

But an Eleventh Rank being making the Ultimate Leap cannot be influenced by external forces; at that time, Eleventh Rank beings will try to fully break free from the constraints of the River of Time.

If a Supreme Being were to interfere during this period, it would be tantamount to contending against the entire River of Time.

Such backlash would even be unbearable for a Supreme Being.

And once the assault on the Ultimate begins.

There are only two outcomes.

Success.

Death.

…

“Xia Qin Supreme Being…”

Lin Yuan took the initiative to step out from the Spatial Layers.

More than a decade ago, when the Xia Qin Supreme Being reached the Milky Way Star Region, he had informed Lin Yuan.

Telling him to transform at ease.

Before the breakthrough, Lin Yuan was undistracted.

But now that he had completely entered the Tenth Rank, it was natural to meet with the Xia Qin Supreme Being.

After all, this Supreme Being had guarded the Milky Way Star Region for nearly twenty years, which counted as placing great importance on Lin Yuan.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan took a step forward, and his figure appeared outside the Milky Way Star Region.

At this moment, there were two figures standing there quietly.

“Xia Qin Supreme Being… and the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being…” Lin Yuan felt a slight shock in his heart.

Of the nine Supreme Beings in human civilization, even if he hadn’t witnessed them all, he was naturally aware of their outer appearances.

“Tower Master Xia Qin, Tower Master Yudie…” Lin Yuan bowed slightly.

The nine Supreme Beings of human civilization each preside over one of the nine Evolution Towers and can also be addressed as ‘Tower Masters’.

The two Supreme Beings, wearing smiles, looked at Lin Yuan and scrutinized him for a moment.

“Lin Yuan, you really surprised me,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said with a trace of emotion.

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being beside him nodded slightly too.

As a Supreme Being, free from the River of Time at the Twelfth-Rank level, what scene had they not seen, what thing had they not experienced?

But with this little fellow Lin Yuan, they kept being ‘shocked’ one after the other.

“Supreme Beings, I…” Lin Yuan hesitated, intending to first reveal a count of the Spatial Layers he opened, lightly disclosing some information.

As for the Mysterious Gourd? Lin Yuan faintly sensed it was of great importance, and no matter the situation, he absolutely could not acknowledge possessing this treasure.

“No need to explain,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being waved his hand, “It’s quite normal for you to have secrets. I have secrets, and so does Yudie.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s smile widened as he looked at Lin Yuan.

At his level, he simply couldn’t be bothered to investigate thoroughly; it was enough that Lin Yuan was a human Evolver.

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan immediately responded.

“I’m not sure about your current strength,” Xia Qin Supreme Being scrutinized Lin Yuan, pondering for a while before speaking, “But you should be comparable to a Grade A Tier 10, right?”

The standard for a Grade A Tier 10 is the comprehension of a new rule after the fusion of two Pillar-level Fusion Rules.

Although Lin Yuan had not yet grasped such Fusion Rules, his foundation was too profound, similar to the notion of one force breaking myriad laws.

“More or less,” Lin Yuan nodded.

In fact, Lin Yuan felt that his current strength even exceeded that of an ordinary Grade A Tier 10.

It couldn’t be helped, after thoroughly understanding the Rule of Time, and with his Inner World fully independent, followed by the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, the enhancement Lin Yuan received was far beyond expectations.

“Very good.”

A smile emerged on Xia Qin Supreme Being’s face.

With the magnitude of human civilization, adding another Grade A Tier 10 being wasn’t a big deal.

At most, it would affect the local situations on large battlefields, nothing more.

However, Lin Yuan’s strength, comparable to Grade A Tier 10, was not the same as a normal Grade A Tier 10.

Whether it was human civilization or other different species, all Grade A Tier 10 beings had reached the limit of strength and potential.

Aside from breaking through to Tier 11, there was no space for further improvement.

But Lin Yuan?

Having just stepped into the Tenth Rank, he was already comparable to Grade A Tier 10.

What would happen once he mastered various Fusion Rules, or even the Pillar-level Fusion Rules?

If an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse didn’t intervene, who could be Lin Yuan’s opponent?

“But don’t get cocky,” Xia Qin Supreme Being’s tone shifted slightly, becoming more serious, “Our expectation for you is not to remain at the Tenth Rank or even the Eleventh Rank.”

“It is the Ultimate, the Twelfth Rank.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan, and the smile on the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being’s face had also faded.

In the Cosmic Starry Sky, what measures the strength and weakness of the peak clans’ foundations is always the combat power of the Supreme Beings.

Without becoming a Supreme Being, one is ultimately just a being within the River of Time, bound by the limits of lifespan, fated to grow old and die one day.

No matter how unprecedented Lin Yuan’s talent and qualifications are, only by entering the realm of the Twelfth Rank Level can he maintain eternity.
